rationale: Pulp's native plug-in screenshot API accepted an explicit GPU backend but the two public render_to_png dispatchers fell through to their raster implementations after an optional provider declined the request. This change routes that existing explicit backend to render_to_png_gpu on Apple and non-Apple builds, preserving fail-closed backend selection and allowing Pulp's Spectr migration to prove that its native state atlas is rendered by Skia Graphite on Dawn rather than a raster substitute. This is Pulp-only plug-in validation and capture integration with no named immutable Vellum framework commit to backport.
